IPT.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/15] During the second phase, which was adapted from the problemsolving model developed by Robin and Foster,37 the family members focus on communication and problemsolving skills and the alteration of family interactional patterns. Systemic behavior family therapy provides extensive socialization to the treatment model and education about depression, parenting and developmental issues and emphasizes skill building and positive practice in sessions and at home.
